request.text:
<young, tired, dry working voice Mood: sad.> The watch says the goblins scattered when their old woman fell. Scattered where, in this cold?
<long pause>
<young, tired, dry working voice Mood: idle.> Carried my first sack up the goblin path today. The little ones watched me the whole way.
<long pause>
<young, tired, dry working voice Mood: idle.> Ground under the docks went cold as a grave. Nobody's saying why.
<long pause>
<young, tired, dry working voice Mood: idle.> Hands are cold, but they still work. That's something.
